hero.title: Building reliable software through testing and automation.
hero.description: QA Engineer and Computer Systems Engineer focused on functional testing and test automation. I build reliable and maintainable testing solutions using Playwright, Python and modern QA practices.

about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I’m a Computer Systems Engineer and QA Engineer focused on software quality, functional testing, and test automation. I enjoy building reliable testing solutions that help detect issues early, improve product stability, and support better user experiences.
about.paragraph2: My current focus is QA Automation, working mainly with Playwright, Python, Pytest, API testing, and modern testing practices. I’m continuously strengthening my skills in automation architecture, cross-browser testing, test stability, reporting, and quality engineering.
about.paragraph3: I’m motivated by continuous learning, problem-solving, and creating maintainable solutions that contribute to more efficient and reliable software development processes.
